name: Afterimage
text: You may play this spell after an ally you control is destroyed as a result of an attack, spell, ability, or dice power an opponent controls. Place that ally into your hand. Deal 2 damage to a target unit that opponent controls.

name: Cataclysm
text: Deal 1 damage to all units and Phoenixborn. If this destroys at least 2 units, place 2 [[Rubble Spirit]] conjurations onto your battlefield.

name: Cinder Spirit
text: Ignite: When this unit is declared as an attacker, if it has 1 or more status tokens on it, add 1 to its attack value for the remainder of the turn. If you do, you may deal 1 damage to another target unit.

name: Double Edge
text: Draw 2 cards. Discard 1 card from your hand. If you discarded, deal 1 damage to a target unit an opponent controls and deal 1 damage to that opponent's target Phoenixborn.

name: Fatal Strike
text: You may play this spell after an opponent takes a Pass main action. Deal 2 damage to a target unit or Phoenixborn that opponent controls.

name: Ocean's Eye
text: Sting 1: When this unit is declared as an attacker, you may deal 1 damage to target wounded unit.

name: Realization
text:
During the draw cards step, you may draw 1 additional card.

[[side]] - [[exhaust]]: If your draw pile is empty, shuffle your discard pile, reveal 1 random card from it, and remove it from the game. Then, reveal another random card from it and add it to your hand.

name: Rising Tides
text: At the end of the next turn this round, deal 1 damage to all units.

name: Rubble Spirit
text: Crumble 1: When this unit comes into play, discard 1 card off the top of a target opponent's draw pile.

name: Spear Master
text:
Replenish 2: When this unit comes into play, and at the end of the round, place 2 status tokens on it.

Spear Volley: When this unit is declared as an attacker, you may remove any number of status tokens from units you control. Deal 1 damage to an equal number of target units that opponents control.

name: Summon Cinder Spirit
text:
[[main]] - [[exhaust]]: Place 1 status token on this spell.

* [[side]] - 1 [[time:class]] - 1 [[basic]]: Move 1 status token from this spell onto a unit you control. If you do, place a [[Cinder Spirit]] conjuration onto your battlefield.

name: Summon Ocean's Eyes
text: [[main]] - [[exhaust]] - 2 [[basic]]: Place two [[Ocean's Eye]] conjurations onto your battlefield.

name: Summon Tusk Mount
text: [[side]] - [[exhaust]] - 2 [[time:class]] - 2 [[basic]]: Remove an unexhausted ally you control from play. If you do, place a [[Tusk Mount]] conjuration onto your battlefield, placing that ally face down under it.

name: Timestopper
text:
~ Swift: After a unit comes into play onto an opponent's battlefield, you may play this unit from your hand without paying its main action cost.

Halt: When this unit comes into play, choose a target unit an opponent controls. That unit cannot attack, block, or guard until the end of the next turn or the round.

name: Tranquility
text:
At the end of your turn, place 1 status token on this spell. Then, if there are 3 or more status tokens on this spell, remove it from the game.

The only side action you may take is Meditate.

name: Tusk Mount
text:
Wreckage 2: After this unit destroys a unit an opponent controls by attacking, place 2 [[Rubble Spirit]] conjurations onto your battlefield.

* Dismount: When this unit is destroyed, place any allies you own underneath this unit into your hand.

name: Vermillion Sage
text:
Study 1: When this unit comes into play, look at the top card of your draw pile and place it on the top or bottom of your draw pile. Then, draw 1 card.

* Inheritance 1: When this unit is destroyed, you may place 1 status token on a target unit.
